scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs stamp dist --app skills
scripts.firebase: pnpm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:skills

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-skills --config firebase.skills-emulator.json "node tests/firestore.test.mjs"
scripts.run:android: pnpm run native:sync && cap run android
